howto.name: Pick stack templates
howto.text: Choose templates such as Node, Python, Vite, Docker, Terraform, Go, Rust, macOS, or Windows.

howto.name: Review the generated file
howto.text: The selected templates are combined into one readable .gitignore with section comments.

howto.name: Copy or download
howto.text: Copy the text or download it directly as .gitignore for your repository root.

faq.q: Does it call the toptal/gitignore API?
faq.a: No. The templates are bundled in the app so the generator works offline and does not leak your selected stack.
Yes. Select any combination and the generated .gitignore groups each template under a comment header.

faq.q: Can I download the file directly?
faq.a: Yes. You can copy the text or download a .gitignore file from the browser.
